card.name: Classroom instructions about what students do
card.fires_on: Small words and verbs right after students, children or a teacher in classroom how-to text, just before the action students are told to do or not do. Examples are to, not, simply and a bare verb.

modes.label: Linking word before a student action
modes.description: The word to or not follows students or children and leads into the instructed action.
modes.example: Allow children<< to>> make items for all of the significant adults

modes.label: Hedge or verb in a teaching step
modes.description: A word like simply, pass or sharing sits just before the verb in a lesson instruction.
modes.example: any student who isn't comfortable volunteering an answer may simply<< pass>> the question on to a classmate.
